instruction: A koi-shaped windsock frozen mid-billow, its tubular body rippling in soft waves from a wide open mouth ring to a fluttering split tail. The surface is iridescent holographic film that shifts teal, magenta and gold across every fold with a faint scanline shimmer. Semi-transparent scale patterns glow along the flanks.
